structure_and_depth.location: reports/current.md, complete lines 1-174; capabilities 9-22, research evolution 24-58, people 60-82, expertise matrix 84-101, timeline 103-117, typed network 119-139, organization synthesis 141-173; analysis/outline.md and retained report-v1.md
structure_and_depth.basis: The full manuscript goes beyond names and paper summaries. It first defines the work objects and dependencies of algorithms, feedback/data, evaluators, reasoning, environments and training systems. The methodological history then explains how DPO relocates work rather than eliminating feedback requirements, why reward evaluation is a distinct capability, and how reasoning and agents add verifier, environment and system dependencies. The people table separates direct contribution disclosures, team outputs, public employment periods and uncertain current status. The expertise matrix interprets those observations without inflating personal ownership. The timeline separates research events, publicly supported movements and corporate/academic name changes; the network retains both edge type and time instead of turning coauthorship into a timeless personal hierarchy. The ending uses these same distinctions to propose conditional combinations for behavior quality, verifiable reasoning, multilingual products and agents. Primary DPO contribution statements substantiate the theory/implementation/evaluation complementarity; Swallow explicitly distinguishes LLM training from instruction-tuning/evaluation responsibilities; HybridFlow's abstract states the training/generation and dataflow system problem invoked by the synthesis. Nathan's career account, Miranda's CV and the HKU alumni entry support the selected movement examples at different time precisions, while Trillium's announcement supports an organizational mission rather than delivered capability. Report sections 159-169 correctly explain that movement does not transfer whole organizational resources and localize uncertain records. The full report materially develops the previously reviewed outline into the required tables and relational analysis. Production history has an outline and one complete manuscript, and the actual retained first-draft difference only narrows a citation's claimed reading location; neither artifact counts nor that small editorial change are offered as research depth. No necessary structural or depth correction was found in the assigned scope.

PTT27/original.txt, members: Rio Yokota is team leader of LLM training and Sakae Mizuki leads instruction tuning and LLM evaluation; these are project roles rather than inferred employment hierarchy.

PTT09/original.txt, career chronology and departure statements; PTT-A03/original.txt, CV page 1 education, employment and disclosed data work; PTT-A04/original.txt, alumni entry and September 2026 update; PTT11/original.txt, October 2026 founding commitment. These support different kinds and precisions of historical/organizational statements.

Complete 174-line manuscript read in three bounded ranges. Effective original task, author handoff, outline, production history and actual report-v1/current difference were inspected. Selected original passages were checked; this is not a claim of full reading of every paper or independent verification of every person's whole career.

domain.basis: 已通读174行完整报告、研究问题和有效要求，核对当前审阅契约差异。领域为模型后训练研究与公开人才归属。技术主线与原件一致：InstructGPT的三阶段及特定标注群体限定；DPO的奖励—策略重参数化、离线偏好与省去显式RM/在线RL；IPO的假设和示例实验；Zephyr的dSFT/AIF/dDPO与未覆盖安全；RewardBench评测奖励而非最终策略；Tülu3的SFT/DPO/RLVR和长上下文、多语言、工具局限。R1-Zero与冷启动R1没有混淆；HybridFlow把分布式模型执行和RL数据流分开；SWE-RL使用补丁相似性而非真实测试奖励，首发版本历史为2025-02-25；RAGEN是受控环境机制研究，K2/K3为团队集成配方，Arctic-SWE为异步系统一致性，SEA-LION/Swallow/Falcon的技术方向保持产物级边界。实际检查了DPO Author Contributions：RR目标推导、EM初始实现/规模训练/评估/人类研究与AS实验组织均有原文；Tülu核心贡献标记、M-RewardBench共同贡献和机构脚注也相符。人物方面，Nathan本人回顾支持2022-05 HF、2023-10 Ai2、2026-06-01最后工作日，10月Trillium公告只表明创立与使命；Miranda本人CV支持2023–25 Ai2及2025起Cambridge，首页说明2026-08实习。Leandro本人当前研究负责人和2023联合公告工程师/BigCode角色分别有据；Lewis机构访谈约九个月与本人公开HF资料没有伪造精确日期。Askell本人职责、邵智宏本人DeepSeek研究/学历、Longguang本人Moonshot参与及K3名单、Zihan本人Northwestern与前瞻实习措辞均核对；Rafael旧主页与Eric新正文/旧页头冲突在受影响条目上保留。HKU机构页确证Guangming毕业2026与first job Tencent，并未推出具体模型团队；Chuan当前教授身份独立于论文；Swallow项目直接给出Rio训练、Sakae指令微调/评测职责，Rio官方履历并任与学校名称改变不被编码为跳槽。Shayekh的Community Researcher来自官方社区，ACL双署名没有被当作雇佣证明。加拿大登记名称历史支持2025-06-02更名，不能推出人员重组。共同成果、时期重叠、人员流动与方法采用的关系边有相应证据/时间；组织建议是能力接口的条件推论，未将作者顺序、知名度、公开数量或团队成果提升为个人全能、现职或管理关系。未发现本领域需要修订的具体缺陷；现职未知与未披露职责保持未知。
